title: Concept: Transitive versions escape central management
description: Directory.Packages.props declares a central-package-management build that does not pin transitive versions, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a central-package-management build that does not pin transitive versions.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Directory.Packages.props (nuget).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a central-package-management build that does not pin transitive versions.
